narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central and eastern Virginia.
ev: Route 3 was closed in the vicinity of Potomac Mills due to high water.
Numerous roads were flooded and impassable from Montross down to the Richmond county line.
Roads were flooded from Warsaw to Oldhams.
Menokin Road was closed due to flooding. Many other roads north and east of Warsaw were flooded and being closed.
Flooding was reported along Route 681 and Kings Highway.
High water was reported over Route 3.
Route 354 (River Road) was flooded near Belle Isle Road.
Route 622 (Morattico Road) was flooded near Nuttsville Road.
Route 3 north of Warsaw was flooded near Oldhams Road.
Route 3 was flooded near Legion Lane and Chandlers Mill Pond. All lanes were flooded and closed.
Route 202 (Hampton Hall Road) was closed at Callao due to vehicles stranded in flood waters.
Valley Drive was flooded. Vehicles were stranded.
Several roads were closed due to flooding around Colonial Beach.
Route 613 was flooded at Farnham Creek Road.
Route 642 (Sharps Road) was flooded near Forest Road.
Route 3 (Mary Ball Road) was flooded. One lane was still passable.
Multiple roads were flooded and closed in Kilmarnock.
Route 622 (Morattico Road) was flooded from Peirces Road to Nuttsville Road.
Route 354 (River Road) was flooded from Bewdley Road to Old Airport Road.
Route 3 (Mary Ball Road) was flooded from Harris Road to Old Salem Road.
Route 202 (Hampton Hall Road) was flooded from Harryhogan Road to Henderson Drive.
Route 605 and a portion of Route 3 (Mary Ball Road) was flooded.
Widespread flash flooding was reported near the Mollusk area. Route 354 was covered with high water and ditches were overflowing in many locations.
Water rescue occurred from a vehicle stranded in about 3 feet of water.
Virginia Department of Transportation camera showed water covering all northbound lanes on Interstate 95 under the Broad Street overpass in downtown Richmond.
Water rescue was reported on Mosby Street.
Water rescue occurred from a stranded vehicle on Magnolia Street.
Route 600 (Lara Road) was flooded from Alfonso Road to Field Trail Road.
Route 621 (Chestnut Hill Road) was flooded near Millpond Road.
Route 638 (China Hill Road) was flooded from Snyder Road to Newland Road.
Route 623 at Finches Hill Road was flooded.
Route 616 was flooded at Oakland Road.
Water rescue occurred on Peach Grove Road due to flood waters on Cat Point Creek resulting from the dam failure of Chandlers Millpond.
Numerous roads around Petersburg were flooded and were impassable. One water rescue was reported.
Numerous roads were flooded across Petersburg, including Defense Road, Squirrel Level Road, Joseph Jenkins at Pocahontas Street, and Mckeer Street at Saint Andrews.
Several roads were flooded across west central Isle of Wight county including Water Works, Magnet Drive, and other locations in the area.
Several roads were flooded near Isle of Wight and Central Hill. Some roads were closed in the area due to flooding.
